column1: # derivation: §9.4: an explicit NULL default is the same as no default, so
# LAG(v, 1, NULL) and LEAD(v, 1, NULL) give the rows of LAG(v) and LEAD(v).
# g = 1 (v 10, NULL, 30): LAG NULL (edge), 10, NULL (id 2's v); LEAD NULL
# (id 2's v), 30, NULL (edge). g = 2 (v 40, 50): LAG NULL, 40; LEAD 50, NULL.
# Types: id, g, v keep their scanned types; each LAG/LEAD column is INT64
# (its values are cells of v, a default that is an INT64 literal (§8.19), or
# NULL) and nullable (§8: no row exempts it).
